hinglish.title: UNIT-5 I ONE SHOT I/O Management and Disk Scheduling I Operating System I by Kapil Sir I AKTU
covers: disk storage structure: track, sector, spindle
seek time, rotational latency, transfer time
all 6 disk scheduling algorithms (FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, C-SCAN, LOOK, C-LOOK)
GATE/AKTU PYQ-style numericals for each algorithm, year-wise
hinglish.why: Only single video found that genuinely covers the ENTIRE T8 scope end-to-end (verified via transcript: I/O buffering -> disk structure/seek time/rotational latency -> all 6 scheduling algorithms with PYQ numericals by year -> RAID) rather than splitting into many short clips. 115K views, 1329 likes (1.15% like/view, healthy for a 117-min niche lecture), Hindi auto-captions present. Alternatives with comparable/higher popularity (Gate Smashers' disk-scheduling series, Last Moment Tuitions, KnowledgeGATE, TutorialsSpace) either split the topic across 7-9 separate videos (breaching the 3-video cap and each missing most of the other algorithms) or lack any captions at all, so were rejected per the syllabus-coverage-first rule.

runners_up.title: L-6.3: Disk Scheduling Algorithm | Operating System
runners_up.reason_rejected: Far higher views/likes than any pick, and has captions, but Gate Smashers splits disk structure + each of the 6 algorithms into 8 separate videos (L-6.1, 6.3-6.9); picking only 3 within the cap would leave most algorithms' numericals uncovered, so the single comprehensive GateWay Classes lecture was preferred for full syllabus coverage.

runners_up.title: FCFS SSTF SCAN CSCAN LOOK CLOOK Solved Example in Hindi | Disk Scheduling Sums

runners_up.title: 8.1 Disk scheduling algorithms in operating system in hindi example track sector seek time
runners_up.reason_rejected: No captions available -- disqualified despite single-video coverage of both disk structure and scheduling algorithms.

runners_up.title: 7.8- All Disk Scheduling Algorithm In Operating System
runners_up.reason_rejected: No captions available; also delivered in Hindi (part of a Hindi-labelled numbered series) despite an English-only title, so would not qualify as an English pick anyway.

runners_up.title: SSTF Disk Scheduling Algorithm
runners_up.reason_rejected: Same excellent English series as the m1oNigNpT5M pick but excluded to stay within the 3-video-per-language cap; students should continue through this channel's SSTF/CSCAN/LOOK/CLOOK videos for full numerical practice.

coverage_gaps: English pick set covers I/O basics and disk structure very well (Neso) plus disk architecture from Sudhakar Atchala, but does not include a top-quality English video showing every one of FCFS/SSTF/SCAN/C-SCAN/LOOK/C-LOOK worked numerically within the 3-video cap -- Sudhakar Atchala's channel has all 6 as separate captioned videos (recommend as follow-up watching) but only one was included in the pick to respect the cap.
